Game Overview

Santa Runner is a action game built around dash through snowy landscapes as Santa in a thrilling race against time. Jump over obstacles and collect festive treats in this endless runner. With simple controls and stunning Christmas visuals, stay hooked as you strive to beat high scores on the global leaderboard. Can you master Santa’s journey?
